Featured Manager · GW1

The Week of Sam

skoeiboy opens with the second-biggest week of his DPL career — built on a $7 waiver bid and a free agent

skoeiboy put 137.65 on the board in GW1 and won by 36.75 over bjennings28, who scored 100.90 and still lost. Four of the twelve highest-scoring starters in the league were his — Cole Palmer 30.05, Maxim De Cuyper 24.00, Emersonn 22.80, Martin Ødegaard 19.00 — with Keane Lewis-Potter 17.60 just outside in 13th.

The biggest surprise of all? De Cuyper and Emersonn. Together they returned 46.80, neither of them drafted — one a $7 waiver claim, the other a free agent nobody else moved on. The rest of it was clean rather than lucky: 1.55 points left on the bench, the lowest figure in the league, with every start that mattered getting the nod.

Sam's making some moves, and not just on the waivers. The trade market has turned out to be his as well — his swap of Sandro Tonali for Youri Tielemans is the only completed trade in the league so far. Watch out for him: he's starting to look like a way-too-early favourite.
